 Print 'Vaaste' singer Dhvani Bhanushali gets ENGAGED to Yash Bhanushali and shares glimpses of her ring and the celebration: 'Found me my cupcake for life, said yessss' Singer Dhvani Bhanushali has announced that she is engaged to Yash Bhanushali. She posted four pictures from the celebration on Instagram, giving fans a look at the couple and her engagement ring. Dhvani Bhanushali’s Instagram post
 Along with the photos, Dhvani wrote, “Found me my cupcake for life. Said yessss (sic).” The pictures show the two sharing warm, happy moments. In one frame, Dhvani is hugging Yash. In another, he kisses her on the cheek while she holds a glass. A third picture has her flashing the ring as the couple poses with a sunset behind them. What the couple wore
 Dhvani chose a brown tank top, a leather skirt and matching footwear for the day. Yash went for a white shirt with a colourful jacket, denim jeans and matching shoes. Watch Dhvani Bhanushali calls police after a fan misbehaves with her Dhvani Bhanushali’s journey in music
 Dhvani Bhanushali started her music career in 2018. She became a household name after ‘Vaaste’ crossed millions of views and ‘Dilbar’ topped the charts. She is also known for ‘Leja Re’, ‘Duniyaa’ from ‘Luka Chuppi’ and ‘Nayan’. She has been called the youngest Indian pop star to achieve such success. Join conversation
 View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments
 Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines 
 In an earlier chat with India Today, she talked about playback singing and her love for pop. She said, “I think playback is great. It is exciting to see whose face your voice matches or vice versa. I am very inclined towards pop, and I feel nobody can tell your story better than yourself.” She added that she likes to tell her own story through her music, but is open to playback work too. “Every time I do a song, I want to focus more on my side of things. As and when I do playback, I am very happy to do it and excited about the opportunities that come my way,” she said. Dhvani Bhanushali has over 7.1 million followers on Instagram. She recently lent her voice to the song 'Ban Piya' from the film 'Suswagatam Khushamadeed', which was released in the year 2024. Poll Vote & Share your view
